verdict.rationale: The only direct statement on liability is UCP's design commitment that businesses "remain the Merchant of Record," which implies the merchant carries transaction responsibility. UCP/AP2 docs also describe fraud-relevant mechanisms: verifiable payment mandates, signed authorizations tied to cart state, and transacting within pre-defined boundaries. None of this is an explicit allocation of fraud or chargeback risk for agent-initiated orders. Missing for 10: documented chargeback/dispute rules for agent-initiated orders, explicit fraud-liability allocation between merchant, agent platform and Shopify, Shopify-specific (not just protocol-level) risk documentation, and independent corroboration.
